correctness.rationale: The full-domain proof reconstructs the parent mixed-Poisson PGF, positivity of the modified law, unique canonical coefficients from quadratic roots, a weak-majorization/complex-root bound for every inflated coefficient, and the exact negative root crossing for deflation. At and below threshold every coefficient is nonnegative with summable intensities; above it all sufficiently high even-order coefficients are negative. Explicit endpoint cases are covered. The delivered SymPy/Fraction checker reproduces the key exact algebra but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A conventional model adjustment (zero inflation and deflation) is analyzed at the sharp boundary of a structurally important infinitely-divisible class of overdispersed counts. The theorem gives a complete criterion for a published one-parameter family, including a nonempty zero-deflation regime retaining compound-Poisson structure and an infinite-order obstruction beyond. This is more than computing routine moments, a low-index negative check, or re-identifying an already-known geometric convolution.
